findings.title: UB-R13 card cap can push the consent CTAs off-screen at iOS accessibility text sizes (Agree unreachable at AX4+ on a 667-pt iPhone SE)
findings.evidence: SmartCompareApp/src/components/AiConsentSheet.tsx: the card gets maxHeight '85%' and only the body ScrollView can shrink. The ScrollView base style is flexGrow 1 / flexShrink 1 (verified in RN 0.81.5 ScrollView.js:1861-1863), bodyScroll sets flexGrow 0, and the title, link and both CTAs default to flexShrink 0. src/ has no maxFontSizeMultiplier or allowFontScaling cap anywhere (grep). The backdrop has justifyContent flex-end, so the card is anchored to the bottom of the screen. Arithmetic (not a device run) on the SE at 375x667: content width 327, cap 567 pt, title 20/30, link and CTA labels 16/24 semibold at about 0.55 em per character, CTA minHeight 48. The fixed parts measure 348 pt at scale 1 (the same as GREEN's figure). At AX2 (1.94) they are about 532 pt, which leaves a body window of about 35 pt, less than one line. At AX3 (2.35) they are about 662 pt, so about 95 pt overflows below the card bottom, which is the screen bottom: 'Not now' is off-screen. At AX4 (2.76) they are about 896 pt and overflow by about 329 pt: 'Agree and continue' is off-screen too, so a sighted large-text user cannot consent and the compare is blocked. On an 844-pt phone (cap 717) the same happens about one step later (AX4/AX5). Without the cap, the bottom-anchored card grows upward: the title is clipped but both CTAs stay on screen. So the wrapper fixes the default-size SE clipping that GREEN computed (684 pt) and trades it for unreachable CTAs at the largest sizes. Pin node 3 ('caps the card at a percentage maxHeight ...') locks this exact design in.
findings.fix: Keep the CTAs reachable at every scale. Preferred: remove the card maxHeight and cap the ScrollView itself with a number from useWindowDimensions (for example bodyScroll maxHeight = round(0.4 * height), with flexGrow 0). The card then stays bottom-anchored and grows upward when the fixed parts are large, and the body still scrolls at normal sizes. Alternatively, set maxFontSizeMultiplier (about 1.5-2) on the sheet's title, link and CTA labels. Either way, re-pin GREEN's node 3 (a GREEN pin, not a RED node) and add the AX3-AX5 sizes to the on-device check UB-R13 already owes.
